Controls.ConvertSelected: Convert Selected Walls to Better Windows

Notifications.NoWallsSelected: No walls selected. Select one or more walls first.
Notifications.TooLargeToVault: This creature is too large to vault through that window.

Config.ClosedMovementHint: Applies only while the window is open. Closed or locked windows always block movement. A size-limited pass-through has no prompts, animation, or rolls.
Config.MaxVaultSizeHint: Tokens of this size or smaller can pass through the open window; larger tokens are blocked even while it's open.

Enabled.Name: Enable Better Window
Enabled.Hint: Turns the entire module on or off. Disabling stops all Better Window behavior (icons, controls, config, movement rules). Requires an application reload after changing.

DefaultVaultSize.Name: Default Vault Size
DefaultVaultSize.Hint: The Max Size to Vault pre-filled on every newly drawn or converted Better Window. Existing windows are unaffected; change it per-window in Wall Configuration.

DefaultMaterial.Name: Default Material
DefaultMaterial.Hint: The Material pre-filled on every newly drawn or converted Better Window. Existing windows are unaffected; change it per-window in Wall Configuration.

DefaultClosedMovement.Name: Default Passage While Open
DefaultClosedMovement.Hint: The Passage While Open setting pre-filled on every newly drawn or converted Better Window. Existing windows are unaffected; change it per-window in Wall Configuration.
